validity.researcher_notes: The line is real and appears in two histories. The Bashkir encyclopedia dates the build to 1966. The Ufa book dates the build start to 1966 and gas arrival to October 1967. The recorded 1967 fits a commissioning year, not a construction year.

verifications.note: Wayback copy of the Ufa transmission company book. Construction of the Kartaly-Magnitogorsk-Sterlitamak and Ishimbay-Ufa lines (571 km) began in 1966, was done in 10 months, and gas reached Ufa on 25 October 1967.
